approvalEvidence.readinessImpact: Resolves the final merge recommendation gate while preserving runtime waiver visibility.

gates.title: Baseline and comparison evidence
gates.evidence: All baseline fields are recorded with zero missing fields.
gates.readinessImpact: Allows file inventory to be compared against the correct PR base.

gates.title: Changed-file inventory coverage
gates.evidence: 56 of 56 PR files are classified exactly once; generated local _bmad-output files are ignored unless force-added as reviewed artifacts.
gates.readinessImpact: No unclassified branch-local files are hidden.

gates.title: Local-assumption removal
gates.evidence: AI-layer defaults use parameters/env vars; no retained ACO/product /Users paths remain; tsbuildinfo files removed.
gates.readinessImpact: Default product surfaces no longer depend on one developer machine.

gates.title: Provider-default safety
gates.evidence: Provider-specific command defaults are optional templates and do not mutate live provider config by default.
gates.readinessImpact: Provider tooling stays opt-in.

gates.title: Missing dependency and fixture closure
gates.evidence: Package, acceptance, server, CLI, and web tests pass with retained fixtures.
gates.readinessImpact: No known retained test depends on missing local-only artifacts.

gates.title: Generated-file reproducibility
gates.evidence: Bundled defaults and API generated types drift checks pass; tsbuildinfo outputs removed.
gates.readinessImpact: Retained generated outputs have regeneration paths.

gates.title: Readiness state contract
gates.evidence: All five readiness states are implemented and tested.
gates.readinessImpact: Missing evidence no longer collapses to ready.

gates.title: Runtime integration truthfulness
gates.evidence: Docs integrations expose explicit runtime states and do not assume MCP/Context7 availability.
gates.readinessImpact: Integration availability is honest.

gates.title: Behavior-driven test replacement
gates.evidence: Critical text-presence assertions are paired with runtime package, API, CLI, web helper, workflow, policy, traceability, and acceptance tests.
gates.readinessImpact: Tests now fail on behavioral regressions.

gates.title: Security hardening
gates.evidence: 12 minimum security scenarios are covered by passing package and acceptance suites.
gates.readinessImpact: No known path traversal, symlink escape, unsafe artifact, or secret leak remains.

gates.title: API contract
gates.evidence: ACO API route tests pass and generated web API types are drift-free.
gates.readinessImpact: Server and web API contracts agree.

gates.title: CLI contract
gates.evidence: ACO/context CLI tests and acceptance tests pass.
gates.readinessImpact: CLI uses canonical readiness semantics.

gates.title: Web contract
gates.evidence: Web readiness helper tests and web build pass; page handles loading and error states.
gates.readinessImpact: UI does not imply readiness for non-ready states.

gates.title: Workflow safety
gates.evidence: Context-orchestrate validates; bundled defaults regenerated; AI-layer defaults parameterized.
gates.readinessImpact: Default workflows avoid local-machine assumptions.

gates.title: Policy gate
gates.evidence: bun run aco:policy passed OPA and fixture checks.
gates.readinessImpact: Policy files are tested release boundaries, not decorative source.

gates.title: Traceability gate
gates.evidence: bun run aco:traceability passed.
gates.readinessImpact: Durable specs remain mapped or explicitly handled.

gates.title: Telemetry safety
gates.evidence: Context-orchestrator package tests include telemetry no-leak and safe-degradation coverage.
gates.readinessImpact: Telemetry remains optional and non-blocking.

gates.title: BMAD routing
gates.evidence: Required routing cases and slash-goal route case pass.
gates.readinessImpact: Ambiguous prompts no longer silently default to full brownfield routing.

gates.title: Documentation-only gate prevention
gates.evidence: Every hard-gate pass records code, test, workflow, drift check, validation, or removal evidence.
gates.readinessImpact: Runtime claims are not documentation-only.

gates.title: Not-applicable evidence
gates.evidence: No hard gate is marked not_applicable.
gates.readinessImpact: No risky surface is hidden behind not_applicable.

gates.title: Final validation commands
gates.evidence: bun run validate now passes after preserving and formatting the unrelated untracked _bmad-output markdown files.
gates.readinessImpact: Validation no longer blocks merge readiness.

gates.title: Final merge recommendation
gates.evidence: Final recommendation is exactly ready; the user approved preserving graph-waiver.bmad-plugins-marketplace and graph-waiver.bmad-sample-data for this run while the runtime status continues to expose the current commit-derived approval contract.
gates.readinessImpact: Reviewer receives a ready merge recommendation with explicit waiver approval evidence and unchanged runtime waiver visibility.
